column1: # Formats read from a KVR Studio Manager scan log (macOS, 2026-09-13).
# Read by `pnpm identifiers:apply --rows`.
# target<TAB>format<TAB>identifier<TAB>version<TAB>source
#   identifier `-` adds the format alone: the log carries no bundle ids at
#   all, only name/brand/version/format per scanned plugin, so every row
#   here is a format the entry ships in and did not list.
# The scan's 1687 plugin rows collapse to 1267 products; 137 resolved to a
# catalog entry on an exact or punctuation-insensitive name match under the
# same manufacturer, and only these five lacked a format they were observed
# in. Versions went through `add-telemetry-versions.ts` instead, which is
# the lane that owns them (27 entries, see the commit).
# Rejected, and why:
#   fabfilter-*  vst3 versions  — FabFilter's VST3 bundles report a two-digit
#       minor with an inserted dot ("3.2.3.0" where the AU and AAX bundles of
#       the same install both read "3.23"). Every FabFilter version below was
#       taken from the format majority, so the mangled reading is outvoted
#       rather than written. A scan carrying VST3 alone for this maker has no
#       usable version.
#   soundtheory-gullfoss  au    — the shell lists only VST3 for Gullfoss; the
#       entry's AU is not evidenced by this log either way.
# Not matched, left for a person or a later import:
#   ~1077 Waves names are WaveShell component names (per-band and per-channel
#       variants, shorthand: "RCompressor", "SSLComp", "Q4", "REQ 6"), which
#       do not stand 1:1 against catalog product names. Fuzzy-matching these
#       is what the reviewed-list contract exists to avoid.
#   44 Universal Audio names are members of "Collection" entries, the known
#       limitation already recorded in 2026-09-identifier-backfill-telemetry.tsv
#       (one `identifiers` value per format cannot express a collection).
#   roli ROLI Studio Player / ROLI Studio Drums — no `roli` product entries
#       exist in any collection; a genuine gap, needs a real import.
#   roland SP-404MKII (VST3, Roland Cloud) — no SP-404MKII entry in software
#       or hardware; a genuine gap.
#   soundtheory Gullfoss Live / Gullfoss Master — separate products from
#       Gullfoss, neither in the catalog.
#   native-instruments Kontakt 7 / Kontakt 8 — the catalog models Kontakt as
#       one entry with a version history, not per-major entries. Correct as is.
#   sonible smartReverb / smartComp2 — the scan is v1 and v2, the catalog
#       carries smart:reverb 2 and smart:comp 3. Already recorded in the
#       telemetry review list.
# Also noticed, out of scope for this pass: waves-rs56 duplicates
# waves-abbey-road-rs56-passive-eq, and waves-the-king-s-microphones
# duplicates waves-abbey-road-the-king-s-microphones.
# SECOND PASS: the response half of the log.
# The first pass read only the request the app POSTs. The response KVR sends
# back matches every scanned plugin to its own product database and carries
# `pdbPath` (a canonical product slug), `pdbVersion` (the newest version KVR
# knows) and `status`. `pdbPath` collapses the 1687 rows to 306 products and
# resolves the WaveShell shorthand the first pass had to give up on:
# RCompressor -> Renaissance Compressor, SSLEQ -> SSL G-Equalizer,
# REQ 6 -> Renaissance Equalizer, GW PianoCentric -> Greg Wells PianoCentric.
# 218 of the 306 resolved to a catalog entry.
# `pdbPath` IS AN UPGRADE POINTER, NOT A PRODUCT IDENTITY. 1490 of the rows
# carry status `pdbNewer`, and for those KVR names the product it wants you to
# upgrade TO, not the one installed. Matching on it without a guard writes an
# older product's data onto its successor's entry:
#   installed Pro-Q 3  ->  pro-q-4-by-fabfilter
#   installed Pro-C 2  ->  pro-c-3-by-fabfilter
#   installed Pro-R    ->  pro-r-2-by-fabfilter
# Rejected by the generation guard (catalog name carries a trailing generation
# token none of the scanned names share), and left for a person:
#   fabfilter-pro-q-4   catalog "Pro-Q 4"  scanned "Pro-Q 3"
#   fabfilter-pro-c-3   catalog "Pro-C 3"  scanned "Pro-C 2"
#   fabfilter-pro-r-2   catalog "Pro-R 2"  scanned "Pro-R"
#   waves-gtr3          catalog "GTR3"     scanned "GTR Tuner" / "GTR Stomp 6"
#       (an over-rejection: the GTR3 components do not carry the line's "3".
#        Harmless, and cheaper than loosening the guard.)
# `pdbVersion` is aggregator-sourced and was written deliberately, on an
# explicit call, for all 203 entries that lacked it. Two things to know before
# trusting it: for Waves it is ONE number (17.1.42, the current shell version)
# replicated across ~200 entries, because Waves versions its whole bundle
# together; and where it could be cross-checked it agreed with the catalog --
# every FabFilter, u-he, Valhalla and Soundtheory pdbVersion was already
# present, which is why only four non-Waves entries gained one.
# The installed-version reconciliation from the first pass still applies here:
# FabFilter's VST3 bundles report "3.2.3.0" where AU and AAX read "3.23", so a
# lone format is outvoted. Kontakt gained no installed version at all because
# KVR maps Kontakt 7 and Kontakt 8 to one product and the two tie.
# No bundle identifiers exist anywhere in the log, in either half. Verified:
# the 1687 product objects carry exactly uid/name/brand/type/category/version/
# format/filename/hidden; the only reverse-domain strings in the file are
# vendor hostnames; the only 32-hex strings are the machine's deviceId. There
# is nothing here for `identifiers` and there never was.
